sections.title: Connectors and subordinate clauses: meaning and form
body: Goal: Link ideas with clear cause, contrast, result, time and condition.
Core vocabulary: en anledning, ett villkor, dessutom. Key phrases: Jag stannar hemma eftersom jag inte mår bra. · Det regnade, så vi tog bussen. · Om du har tid kan vi ses.

Och, men, för and så connect main clauses. Eftersom, när and om begin subordinate clauses. In a subordinate clause, inte normally comes before the finite verb: eftersom jag inte mår bra. If a subordinate clause comes first, the main clause begins with the verb: När bussen kommer går vi ombord.
Say the examples aloud, notice the pattern, and then change one detail rather than memorising a fixed script.

examples.en: I am staying home because I do not feel well.

examples.en: It rained, so we took the bus.

sections.title: Register, evidence and independent use
body: Register model: “Jag kan inte delta eftersom jag är sjuk.” is a formal-neutral explanation way to express “I cannot attend because I am ill.”.
For listening and reading, answer from a specific word or phrase. For speaking and writing, make the recipient, purpose and next action clear.
Attempt the task before using the model. Improve one high-impact feature, then perform it again with the transfer condition.

assignment.title: Four-skill task and transfer
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: First listen without a transcript. Answer: Under what condition will the speaker have enough time? Replay once and identify the exact words that prove the answer.

READ: Read for purpose and evidence. Answer: Why should participants bring gloves? Mark the shortest phrase that supports your choice.

SPEAK: Explain a changed plan with a contrast, a reason and a condition. Begin one sentence with a subordinate clause. Make a first attempt, check clarity and repeat once.

WRITE: Write 80–100 words about a community activity. Explain when it happens, why it matters, one possible problem and what happens if that problem occurs. Check reader, purpose, required details and next action.

TRANSFER: Bad weather moves the activity indoors; revise the information without losing the logical links.

BETWEEN LESSON · Optional, 5 minutes: retrieve the three key phrases without looking, then use one in a new sentence.
